review_context: First L&E discrimination/harassment reviewed-learning signal replay from committed synthetic carrier rejection inputs.
finding_title: Schema-valid reviewed-learning signals need same-case identity anchors.
finding_summary: A carrier rejection learning report can be schema-valid and candidate-only while still belonging to the wrong budget or preflight case. Replay input-pack validation needs deterministic same-case identity checks before a generated learning signal can satisfy a reviewed-learning one-of slot.
observable_context: The first L&E discrimination/harassment clean replay chain produces carrier rejection capture, review packet, learning report, and reviewed-learning gate reports from committed synthetic inputs.

The input-pack audit already validated local refs, Pydantic shape, and no-write boundary flags, but it did not bind reviewed-learning signal reports to the same budget_proposal_id and preflight_packet_id as the declared case anchors.
Committed source-input fixtures may use placeholder IDs such as filled-by-test values that are bound by builders at runtime, so placeholders must not become identity evidence anchors.
The validated fix uses concrete top-level case IDs from local anchor artifacts and rejects case-bound reports whose IDs do not match those anchors.
observable_decision_logic: Schema validation proves artifact shape but not that a learning report belongs to the same replay case.
A reviewed-learning gate one-of signal is only useful for QA if it is tied to the same local synthetic budget and preflight packet as the replay slot.
Placeholder IDs in source-input bundles represent pending runtime binding and should be ignored for identity anchoring rather than treated as contradictory observed facts.
The integrated replay test should generate derived artifacts in a temp run directory, then feed the generated learning report through the input-pack validator as local candidate evidence.
solution_path: Add case identity context for L&E replay input-pack entries using concrete budget_proposal_id and preflight_packet_id anchors.
Apply the identity check to case-bound reports, including carrier rejection review, carrier rejection learning, actuals comparison, variance ledger, and budget revision reports.
Ignore placeholder sentinel IDs when collecting anchors so source-input templates do not create false conflicts.
Add a positive integrated replay test from committed synthetic L&E inputs through carrier learning and reviewed-learning gate.
Add a negative wrong-case learning report test and fail-closed count invariants for carrier learning and reviewed gate reports.
applies_when: A learning-loop or reviewed-gate artifact is used as a replay input signal for a specific synthetic case.
A report has its own budget_proposal_id or preflight_packet_id and can be matched against local case anchors.
Source-input templates contain placeholder IDs that are resolved by builders before generated reports are trusted.
does_not_apply_when: The artifact is a source-input template with unresolved placeholders and is not being used as a generated case-bound report.
The report is intentionally cross-case aggregate evidence with an explicit aggregate contract.
A production Orchestrator owner has already provided a stronger governed matter-linking contract.
danger_if_misapplied: If schema-valid learning reports from another case can satisfy reviewed-learning input slots, QA could mark the wrong synthetic case as learning-ready and later train or promote changes from unrelated evidence.
suggested_actions: DAD should classify schema-valid-but-unbound artifacts as a separate exception pattern from malformed artifacts.
DAD should track placeholder identity values separately from observed case identity values.
Future Rust work should target stable local-ref, schema, no-write, and identity-binding checks only after Python tests remain the oracle.
reviewer_notes: This record contains synthetic fixture references only.
It records observable evidence, assumptions, decision logic, fix refs, and test refs without hidden chain-of-thought.
red_team_notes: Do not treat one-of signal readiness as proof of reviewed learning unless the signal is bound to the intended case.
Do not treat placeholder IDs in source-input bundles as observed facts.
Do not promote this local candidate binding rule as Semantic Substrate canon from the intake repo.
